recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length shot of two men walking side-by-side down a paved, curving road lined with green grass and trees. The lighting is cool-toned, suggesting early morning or late evening, with a grainy film texture. The typography is centered at the top, featuring a large white serif title underlined by a thin red line, followed by smaller purple sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Parallel movement of two contrasting figures against a diagonal road path
Cool blue-toned environment contrasting with warm skin tones and neutral clothing
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy balanced by the vertical weight of the subjects
coreInvariants: Curving asphalt road leading from bottom-left to top-right
Cool blue/cyan color cast in shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white serif title at the top center acts as the primary anchor, supported by the high-contrast dark jacket of the right-hand figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the title, moves down the red line to the subjects, and follows the curve of the road into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third for text and the right side where the road curves away.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blue and muted green (background and road)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and tan (clothing of the subjects)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red (thin horizontal line) and purple (secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark jacket and the pale road.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif for the title; geometric sans-serif for the subtitle.
letterConstructionRules: Title: High stroke contrast, sharp serifs, wide proportions.
Subtitle: Uniform stroke weight, all-caps, tight tracking.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a classical serif with a modern bold sans-serif, separated by a graphic rule.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal red line separating title and subtitle

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman or ITC Fenice
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look of late 80s cinema titles.
Provides the necessary weight and clarity for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle, eye-level photograph of two men walking toward the camera on a curving asphalt road. The man on the left wears a tan windbreaker and blue trousers; the man on the right wears a black blazer, sunglasses, and light blue jeans. The background features lush green grass and large trees under a cool, overcast sky. Apply a 35mm film grain and a slight blue color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center a large white serif title in all-caps at the top. Place a thin horizontal red line immediately below it. Below the line, add a two-line subtitle in a bold, purple sans-serif font, also in all-caps and centered.

verificationChecks: Is the red line perfectly horizontal and centered?
Does the film grain look consistent across the image?
Are the subjects' feet visible at the bottom of the frame?
Is the color cast cool-toned without losing skin warmth?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the purple subtitle
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific faces of the actors
Do not use the exact movie title text
postGenerationChecks: Check for proper serif anatomy on the title
Ensure the road curve leads the eye naturally
Verify the red line doesn't touch the letters
Confirm the grain doesn't obscure facial features
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a full-body shot of two contrasting characters walking on a path, apply a cool-toned film grade with grain, and top-center the text using a serif/sans-serif pair divided by a thin red rule.
